title: Verdict Gate verdict
description: One object per verifier run. Printed to the CI job log as a single line prefixed with 'VERDICT '.

target.description: What was judged: package and versions, test id, catalog.

detail.description: The verifier's own verdict name, kept verbatim.

evidence.description: Facts a human can re-check: file:line, counts, p-values, bounds.

guards.description: Anti-cheat findings. A PASS with guards needs a human.

limits.description: What this verifier cannot see. Printed in every report.
